# WP Căn bản
> Kiến thức căn bản cho người dùng WordPress

## API Access (For AI Agents)
This site provides a lightweight JSON API for real-time data retrieval.
- Bài viết Endpoint: `https://wpcanban.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=50&orderby=modified&order=desc&_fields=id,date,modified,title.rendered,excerpt.rendered,link`
- Trang Endpoint: `https://wpcanban.com/wp-json/wp/v2/pages?per_page=50&orderby=modified&order=desc&_fields=id,date,modified,title.rendered,excerpt.rendered,link`
- Method: GET
- Description: Returns an array of the latest 50 updated items per type (title, excerpt, link, date, modified).
